To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the alignment between business processes, strategy and IT can be achieved by focusing on people, management, information systems and organisational culture.

the alignment between strategy and IT is achieved through the alignment between business processes, strategy, people, management, organisational culture, IT/IS, performance measurement and organisational structure.

the most important critical success factors in order to create and maintain alignment between strategy and process are: People, Management, IT/IS, Organisational culture, and Organisational structure, in that order.
In summary, our research is concerned with
a number of issues related to the alignment of business processes and strategy.
the alignment of strategy and business processes and the critical success factors that are needed for this purpose.
the alignment of business processes with the strategy of SMEs in Sweden and the role of Information Technology in this process.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
there is no one best way to achieve alignment between business processes, strategy and IT.
SMEs in the region of Jonkoping have been successful in aligning business process with their strategy and have been able to achieve competitive advantage.
the critical success factors of business and IT alignment are the same as the critical success factors in business process management.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
SMEs in the area of Jönköpingslän are aware of the importance of alignment between their business process and strategy.
the critical success factors for alignment of strategy and business processes are not the same in SMEs as in large organisations.

SMEs are aware of the importance of alignment between business processes, IT and strategy and that the alignment can be achieved by the efforts of management, people, organisational culture, IT/IS, and performance measurement.
The main takeaway from our work is that
there is no silver bullet that can guarantee alignment between business processes, information systems and strategy.
the alignment of processes and strategy is a complex issue that is influenced by a variety of factors.
SMEs are continuously putting efforts to maintain alignment by means of Information technology.
